question: Within a 100 kilometers distance, where can I find a fast food restaurant on the path toward Giant Wheel at Irvine Spectrum Center, Irvine, CA from Alta Vista Gardens, Vista, CA?
sql: WITH start_point AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Alta Vista Gardens%' LIMIT 1 ), end_point AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Giant Wheel at Irvine Spectrum Center%' LIMIT 1 ), path_line AS ( SELECT ST_MakeLine(start_point.geometry, end_point.geometry) AS geom FROM start_point, end_point ), path_corridor AS ( -- Create a 5 km buffer around the path to define the "on the path toward" area SELECT ST_Buffer(path_line.geom::geography, 5000) AS geom FROM path_line ) SELECT P.poi_name, P.addr_city, P.addr_state FROM pois AS P, start_point AS SP WHERE P.amenity = 'fast_food' -- Ensure the fast food restaurant is within 100 kilometers of the starting point AND ST_DWithin(P.geometry::geography, SP.geometry::geography, 100000) -- 100 kilometers = 100,000 meters -- Ensure the fast food restaurant is within the defined path corridor AND ST_Intersects(P.geometry::geography, (SELECT geom FROM path_corridor));
